title: Azure CLI sign-in state
whyItMatters: Cached Azure sign-in tokens and subscription settings let someone use the account's cloud access from this machine.
source: Azure CLI configuration and cached credentials in ~/.azure: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/azure-cli-configuration
notes: Older CLI versions use accessTokens.json; newer ones use an MSAL token cache. Both sit in this folder.
